outcome: frequency of scar endometriosis after C/S
clinical presentation of abdominal wall endometriosis
sonographic features of abdominal wall endometriosis
CT and MRI appearance of abdominal wall endometriosis
cohort: 12 surgically proven cases of abdominal wall endometriosis from January 2008 to December 2012.
finding: Abdominal wall endometriosis frequently presented with noncyclic symptoms, and imaging findings of a solid mass near a cesarean section scar strongly suggested its diagnosis.
mod_finding: All patients had a history of at least one prior cesarean section.
